title: Reliant Kore (MISC, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Reliant Kore is a light two-seat transport from MISC in Star Citizen. Its cockpit can turn between flying flat and flying upright. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: Reliant Kore: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Reliant Kore's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Cargo (6 SCU)
controls.text: The Reliant Kore takes 6 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

controls.name: Thrusters
controls.text: Wings in the style of the alien Xi'an and thrusters that can push in every direction.
controls.context: They let the Reliant Kore move nimbly for its size; the left stick slides it in any direction.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: Reliant Kore: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the Reliant Kore besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Co-pilot seat
controls.text: A second seat beside the pilot of the Reliant Kore. More people on board can share the work.
controls.context: A second person on board can take over jobs such as turrets, scanning or the radio, so the pilot can concentrate on flying.
